title: Personal Knowledge Reconstruction Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Reassembles project histories and the reasoning behind decisions from authorized records. A proposed engine that rebuilds lost context: from authorized records — documents, messages, commits, notes — it reassembles project histories and reconstructs the reasoning behind past decisions, so teams can answer "why did we choose this?" years later. It only uses records it is authorized to read, and marks every inference as reconstructed rather than recorded.
capabilities: Reassemble project histories from authorized records
Reconstruct the reasoning behind past decisions
Label every inference with confidence
Respect record-level authorization strictly
Distinguish reconstructed reasoning from recorded fact
